name: Murrieta Youth Advisory Committee
org: City of Murrieta Community Services Department
what_you_do: Be the teen voice for the city. You plan youth events, art shows and community drives, learn how city government works, and pick up job readiness skills and volunteer hours.
who_can_apply: Teens who live in the City of Murrieta and are in 9th to 12th grade at a Murrieta Valley Unified School District school. You need two references.
duration: Nine months, October to May, with an optional extended summer term; meetings in the evening
deadline_text: The 2024-25 round took applications Aug 6 to Aug 30, 2024, with interviews in early September. Newer dates not found; expect a late summer window.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application with five short answers and two references. Turn it in at the Murrieta Youth Center (40644 California Oaks Rd) or email it to the city contact on the sheet. Questions: Community Services at (951) 304-PARK, ext. 6117.
notes: Confirm first: the only sheet found is for the 2024-25 term. Members must go to all mandatory city events. Meetings were on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday evenings.
